source: Every table is explicit {name,text}; originals retain UTF8 BOM, CRLF and physical record ranges, bytes and SHA256. Immutable editions bind complete settings and original sources. Header-only means explicitly empty. No platform API or undocumented importer.

semantics.resources: kind technician|bay. One declared technician and optional bay per active job. Resource windows state available|blocked; half-open exact instants; adjacent available windows may cover a continuous occupancy. Unavailable or overlapping resource intervals yield attention, never a reschedule.
semantics.bookings: Full replacement revisions have stable job/customer/vehicle identity and strictly increasing revision/recorded_at order. status scheduled|confirmed|in_progress|completed|cancelled|postponed. Select latest recorded_at <= asOf; preserve future revisions. Original is earliest eligible source revision. A cancelled/postponed revision reserves no planned occupancy. Each resource has its own integer before/after buffer; no route, distance or travel duration is inferred. Actual selected window is compared with explicit operating-day boundaries. Rebooked-outside-day jobs retain their history.
semantics.quotes: Each source line is bound to a specific booking revision. amount_minor is signed integer; no tax rate, fee, price-from or deposit percentage is inferred. Missing quote is unknown, not zero. Currency stays per job/revision.
semantics.completions: One current observation per job per edition. status not_started|in_progress|completed|cancelled|postponed. Completed requires start/end; in_progress requires start and no fabricated end. Actual assigned technician/bay are explicit. Completion is observed independently from booking status; mismatches and time/resource conflicts remain visible. A later source edition corrects a snapshot.
semantics.invoices: Signed original invoice lines reference actual job and invoice; negative credits remain. Compare recorded invoice totals with the selected quoted lines only when both exist. All totals remain by currency. Invoice records never prove physical completion.
semantics.payments: kind received|refund, positive amount_minor. Refund explicitly names original received transaction and same currency. Aggregate over-refund is attention. No charge is generated. Methods and references remain literal.
semantics.allocations: Positive current snapshot per unique allocation_id links one transaction to a job and optional invoice. purpose deposit|settlement|refund. Refund allocations require refund transactions; ordinary deposit/settlement use received transactions. Every signed paid allocation contributes only once to a job's available credit. Invoice allocations must reference an actual invoice line for the same job/currency. Allocation excess, refund allocation mismatch and unallocated transaction balance remain visible. Transfer a deposit by a corrected full allocation source in a new edition, retaining all prior allocation decisions and authorization; do not duplicate the payment receipt.
semantics.day: settings.dayStart/dayEnd are explicit offset instants spanning the actual owned day, at most 36 hours; asOf is explicit offset instant. Results retain actual offset strings. No recurring rules or local-time zone lookup is inferred. Future bookings/observations/payments stay source-retained and separately visible; current analysis uses asOf.
semantics.reviews: subjectType booking|resource|invoice|payment|allocation; id is the exact analysis subject key. disposition investigate|accept_expected. Records annotate original quantities without changing them, bind edition/sourceHash and chain previousReviewId for the exact subject. No automatic cancellation/weather fee or refund decision.

native: Preserve exact tjlabs.detail-day-desk.v1 {workspace,session,nativeContinuation?}; append core while retaining complete current session. Selected old edition/drafts remain until explicit selection of new edition. Create-only outputs retain original input/command bytes and readable malformed receipts.
